meta.name: claap-weekly-recap
meta.description: Turns a week of Claap-recorded sales calls into action items and focus blocks on a Notion Kanban, delivered with a Slack summary. Use when the user says 'weekly call recap', 'turn my calls into action items', 'Sunday recap from Claap', 'what should I focus on next week based on my calls', 'pull this week's deal next steps from Claap', or schedules a recurring digest of recorded conversations. Side-effecting — reads Claap via MCP, writes Notion cards, sends a Slack DM. On first run with no config it enters an interactive SETUP MODE that walks the user through wiring everything up — no failed scheduled runs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把销售通话自动转为待办事项和下周重点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每周要整理大量销售通话记录并安排后续行动
copy.tagline_en: Turn sales calls into action items and focus blocks automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn weekly sales calls into actionable tasks and priorities

howto.what: 读取指定天数内的 Claap 销售通话录音，提取每笔交易的待办事项和下周重点，自动创建 Notion 看板卡片，并通过 Slack 发送周报摘要。
howto.when: 当你说“weekly call recap”等关键词，或你安排定期（如每周日）运行此技能时触发。首次无配置时会进入设置流程。

say.text: 帮我总结本周的销售电话，生成行动项。
设置每周日自动从 Claap 生成 Notion 看板和 Slack 摘要。
say.note: 会引导你完成首次配置，之后自动运行。

say.text: 从 Claap 通话中提取下周的重点工作。
say.note: 基于通话内容生成焦点块并更新看板。

howto.what_en: Reads Claap-recorded sales calls from the past N days, extracts per-deal action items and weekly focus blocks, writes them to a Notion Kanban DB, and delivers a Slack summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like 'weekly call recap' or schedule a recurring digest. Enters setup mode on first run if config is missing.

say_en.text: Give me my weekly call recap from Claap to Notion and Slack.
say_en.note: It will process calls and output action items and focus blocks.

say_en.text: Set up a weekly summary from my Claap calls.
say_en.note: Guides you through configuration, then runs automatically on schedule.

say_en.text: What should I focus on next week based on my calls?
say_en.note: Extracts focus blocks from the week's recordings.
